verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a work-management product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Asana offering a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of its core product. The only 'self-hostable' mention describes n8n, a third-party integration, and the developer sandbox is a temporary hosted Asana domain, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
